ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What is right under the tongue?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a schematic diagram of an open oral cavity; in the lower central part there is a large pink muscular structure, which is the tongue, and label D is placed on the tongue. Directly below/under the tongue, at the bottom of the oral cavity, is the region that forms the floor of the oral cavity. Reasoning: The question asks “what is directly under the tongue,” not which letter label. According to oral anatomy, the structure located under the tongue and forming the bottom of the oral cavity is called the floor of mouth.
